resources.string: While the charger is plugged in, the battery stops charging at %1$d%% and the phone runs from the charger instead, so the battery stays cooler while gaming or recording. Charging resumes when the battery drops to %2$d%%.\n\nBelow that level the phone charges normally. This uses Settings > Battery > Charging control (limit mode); your previous charging control settings come back when bypass is turned off.
